Warren County Fiscal Court
Meeting Minutes
July 30, 2026
Pursuant to adjournment, Warren Fiscal Court met on Thursday, July 30, 2026 at
9:00 AM in the Warren County Fiscal Courtroom at 429 E 10th Avenue, Bowling
Green, Kentucky. Present were: Esquire Eric Aldridge, Esquire Ron Cummings,
Esquire Scott Lasley, Esquire Tom Lawrence, and Esquire Rex McWhorter, and
Esquire Rick Williams. Presiding Judge Executive Doug Gorman.
**********
Invocation by Bridget Kehrt-Groce, Executive Director, Christian Family Radio.
**********
Esquire McWhorter led the pledge to the flag.
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve minutes of the
Fiscal Court meeting on July 9, 2026. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no
nays. It is so ordered. (4)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve personnel
changes for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (5)
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve work schedule
for the Warren County Road Department. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas,
no nays. It is so ordered. (6)
**********
Proclamation for Parks and Rec Month
Ed Moss Recognition and Proclamation
NACo Award Presentation by Sam Ford
Retirement Recognitions for Ronnie Pearson and James Marcrum
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve the 2025 Oil and
Limestone Settlement for the Warren County Sheriff’s Office. Upon roll call the
vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (7)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve Treasurer’s
Report for June 2026. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (8)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve emergency
determination in the amount of $15,975 to Stewart Richey Service Group for
plumbing repair for collapsed drain lines in A-Unit hallway at the jail. Upon roll
call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (9)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve determination in
the amount of $18,720 to Autonomy Today for yearly renewal for the CADMUS
System at the jail. (Single Source). Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays.
It is so ordered. (10)
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to accept quarterly
financial reports from Hadley, Alvaton, and Plano Fire Departments. Upon roll call
the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (11)
**********
Due to an appeal notice received just prior to court, the magistrates voted on a hearing.
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to grant a hearing on the
record on August 13, 2026 at 8:30 AM for the appeal regarding rezoning property
located at 5488, 5538, and 5558 Scottsville Road from AG (Agriculture) and GB
(General Business) to HB (Highway business) containing approximately 2.20 acres
and presently owned by Josh Baker; Jeff & Valerie Powell; and Tristan & Kamrin
Summer Adams. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered.
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve
determination in the amount of $22,739.53 to DetectaChem for the purchase of a
handheld near-infrared spectrometer drug detection device for the jail. Paid for
with WCRJ Canteen Funds. (Single Source). Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas,
no nays. It is so ordered. (12)
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve first reading of
Ordinance #26-20WC Establishing the Warren County Department of Public Safety
and Providing for The Administration of Fire Protection and Emergency
Management Services. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (13)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to authorize Parks
Department to advertise for the newly-created position of Outreach Division
Coordinator. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (14)
**********
Esquire Cummings moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to authorize Judge
Executive to execute all related documents for the grant application with the City,
County, ITA, and Chamber of Commerce for HUD’s PRO Housing Program. Upon
roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order
Book 21, Supp. 240, 566-A-3). (15)
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve updates to
the Warren County Sheriff’s Office Policy Manual. Upon roll call the vote was:
seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (16)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve Order #26-30
Appointing Chase Carpenter to the Code Enforcement Board. Upon roll call the
vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21,
Supp. 240, 567-A). (17)
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve 4th Quarter
Financial Report for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no
nays. It is so ordered. (18)
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to grant authority to
advertise for bids for assorted fire department tools and equipment to partially
equip new fire apparatus currently on order, with an anticipated delivery date of
January 2027. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (19)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve lease agreement
with Enterprise Fleet for a 2026 Chevrolet Silverado 2500 for the Warren County
Department of Public Safety in an amount not to exceed $1350.00 per month for 60
months. (Contracted Vendor). Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (20)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve Order #26-31
Declaring Surplus Equipment for Parks and Rec. Upon roll call the vote was: seven
yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 567-B-
1). (21)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve determination in
the amount of $59,131 to Tennis Technologies for resurfacing of the six (6) outdoor
courts at the tennis facility at Buchanon Park. (Purchase Pros Pricing). Upon roll
call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (22)
**********
Esquire Williams moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve determination
in the amount of $4,565 to Sunbelt Rentals for rental of 15 light towers and 5 digital
message boards by the Parks Department for an event to be held at Phil Moore
Park. Cost will be covered by event sponsor. (Three quotes obtained. Lowest and
best.) Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (23)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve
determination in the amount of $8,750 to Warren County Public Library for the
sponsorship of Duncan Hines Days. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays.
It is so ordered. (24)
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve 2026 Treasurer’s
Settlement for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (25)
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve emergency
determination in the amount of $63,252 to Scott, Murphy, & Daniel for critical
repairs to storm shelters at Basil Griffin, Buchanon, and Ephram White Parks.
Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (26)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve
Memorandum of Agreement with Western Kentucky University Federal Work
Study Program to allow for up to 75% wage reimbursement for participating
students that work for the Parks Department under the terms of the federal
program and authorize Judge Executive to execute all related documents. Upon roll
call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book
21, Supp. 240, 568-A-1). (27)
**********
Esquire McWhorter moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve
Memorandum of Agreement with Barren River Area Development District for the
meal distribution program at the Senior Center and authorize Judge Executive to
execute all related documents. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 568-B-1). (28)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve Memorandum
of Agreement with the Pritchard Committee for Academic Excellence for
continuation of partnership to mutually provide recreational services as part of the
Bowling Green Promise Neighborhood Project and authorize Judge Executive to
execute all related documents. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240, 568-C-1). (29)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve Warren County
Regional Jail Canteen Account Financial Report for June 2026 and the Fiscal Year
25-26 summary. Upon roll call the vote was: six yeas, one nay. It is so ordered. (30)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Lasley to approve emergency
determination in the amount of $7,993 to Trane Inc. for the replacement of an air
conditioner compressor at the jail that services inmate living areas. Upon roll call
the vote was: six yeas, one nay. It is so ordered. (31)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve determination
in the amount of $21,000 to Reynolds Sealing and Striping for repairs to the inline
hockey rink at Griffin Park. (Purchase Pros Pricing). Upon roll call the vote was:
seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (32)
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge to approve Resolution #26-09
Authorizing the Judge Executive to Make Application for And, Upon Approval, To
Enter into An Agreement with The Kentucky Office of Homeland Security (KOHS),
To Execute Any Documents Which Are Deemed Necessary by KOHS to Facilitate
and Administer the Project and To Act as The Authorized Correspondent for This
Project. This Resolution Also Establishes Procurement Policy for Any KOHS
Approved Project for the FY-2026 Application Cycle. Upon roll call the vote was:
seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21, Supp. 240,
569-A-1). (33)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve lease
agreement with Enterprise Fleet for two (2) 2026 Dodge Durangos in an amount not
to exceed $850 per month per vehicle for 60 months for the Sheriff’s Department.
(Contracted vendor). Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so
ordered. (34)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Williams to approve determination
in the amount of $14,434 to Enterprise Fleet for striping and equipment to outfit the
(2) 2026 Dodge Durangos for the Sheriff’s Department. (Contracted vendor). Upon
roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (35)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire Cummings to approve interfund
transfers for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (36)
**********
Esquire Aldridge moved, seconded by Esquire McWhorter to approve budget
transfers for Warren County. Upon roll call the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is
so ordered. (37)
**********
Esquire Lasley moved, seconded by Esquire Lawrence to approve Order #26-29
Reappointing Christiaan Volkert to the Airport Board of Directors. Upon roll call
the vote was: seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (See Fiscal Court Order Book 21,
Supp. 240, 569-B). (38)
**********
Magistrates present were given a copy of claims to be paid and after examination of
all claims the following motion was made: Esquire Cummings moved seconded by
Esquire McWhorter to approve claims as submitted. Upon roll call the vote was:
seven yeas, no nays. It is so ordered. (39)
**********
Esquire Lawrence moved, seconded by Esquire Aldridge that court adjourn to meet
again on Thursday, August 13, 2026 at 9:00 AM. It is so ordered.

DOUGLAS J. GORMAN
WARREN COUNTY JUDGE EXECUTIVE
